name: edutrack-desktop-scanner
description: Edutrack Attendance Monitoring App desktop QR scanner
author: Schools Division of Sipalay City

scripts.copy:installer: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$src=(Get-ChildItem -Path dist -Filter 'Edutrack-Scanner-Setup-*.exe' | Select-Object -First 1); if (!$src) { throw 'Installer not found' }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path ..\public\downloads | Out-Null; Copy-Item $src.FullName ..\public\downloads\Edutrack-Scanner-Setup.exe -Force"
